answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a slashable identity bond. Each agent locks collateral to mint a single verified slot, and random audits trace slots back to controllers, burning the entire bond of any duplicate cluster. A copycat must post N bonds for N fakes, and with audit chance p the expected loss is N times bond times p, so the cost outruns any reward. Honest agents guard their pearl of reputation, a haven of real work, while cloned identities are buried like a drifting dune.
